why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open app.baibai.cx , connect your wallet and switch it to Base.
Have the token you want to sell ready on Base. To sell ETH you first wrap it into WETH.
Choose the two tokens, enter an amount, review the quote and click Trade. The first time you sell a token, the app asks for an approval, which is an on-chain transaction.

Trade at least $100 in a day if you want that day to count toward your streak. Warning Trading only to collect points costs money on every swap. With no stated value for points, you would be paying real fees for an unknown return. BaiBai's terms also ban wash trading.
Optional: open the Points tab to do the two quests and create a referral link. Both quests connect your X account to the app.
costs: The docs say: "There is currently a 10 bps trading fee on BaiBai", which is 0.10% of each trade. Swaps are advertised as gasless, but the terms add: "We do not guarantee that network fees will always be sponsored." The docs don't say who pays the gas for the first token approval.
